messages:
Alex (Support): Customer reports promo claim flow shows success in UI and confirmation email, but org balance unchanged. Org: org_0001 (acme-corp), user: jdoe@acme.com. Happened after partner SSO flow.
Jordan (Billing): Thanks — can you paste the webhook payload and any claim_id you see?
Alex (Support): Pasted below from our webhook ingestion logs (sanitized):
```json
{
  "claim_id": "cl_abc123",
  "org_id": "org_0001",
  "code": "ACME2026",
  "amount_cents": 10000,
  "status": "accepted",
  "applied_to": "billing_account:acct_01"
}
```
Alex (Support): Customer also got a confirmation email and the webhook returned 200 from our partner endpoint. They used our public claim endpoint: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/promos/claim
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"code":"ACME2026"}'
```
Liz (Platform): Quick note: payload shows applied_to = billing_account:acct_01. For org_0001 our ledger writes should target org ledger, not a standalone billing_account. Could be a tenant->billing_profile mapping issue (partner SSO linked account created a billing_account but not attached to org).
Jordan (Billing): I queried the ledger for claim_id cl_abc123 — nothing posted. Claim row exists in promos.claims table, status accepted, but ledger_write job logged an error.
Alex (Support): Here's the relevant log snippet from ledger-writer (truncated):
```
[2026-03-15T14:12:05Z] ERROR ledger_writer: claim_id=cl_abc123 skip_write no_billing_profile for billing_account acct_01
[2026-03-15T14:12:05Z] WARN ledger_writer: claim cl_abc123 not persisted due to missing billing_profile
```
Liz (Platform): That matches my hypothesis. If billing_profile is missing for acct_01 the write is skipped to avoid orphan credits. @Jordan can you confirm whether acct_01 should map to org_0001? If yes we can create the missing mapping and re-run the one-off ledger job.
Jordan (Billing): Confirmed acct_01 belongs to a partner-linked subaccount that didn't get a billing_profile created during SSO onboarding. I can create the profile but want @Liz to run the dry-run first.
Liz (Platform): Repro steps I'm going to run now: 1) fetch claim row: SELECT * FROM promos.claims WHERE claim_id='cl_abc123'; 2) run ledger_writer --claim cl_abc123 --dry-run to show writes; 3) if dry-run shows billing_profile missing, create billing_profile for acct_01 and run ledger_writer --claim cl_abc123 --force.
Alex (Support): Customer asked for ETA — can we get an estimate?
Liz (Platform): I can create mapping and re-run in ~30 minutes. Will report back here with ledger entry ID if successful.
Jordan (Billing): After Liz confirms, I'll notify the customer and include the ledger write id and updated balance.
Alex (Support): Filed support ticket SUP-2345 and added reproducible steps + pasted logs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Liz (Platform): Quick follow-up: adding a small fix to onboarding flow to ensure billing_profile creation for partner-linked accounts, opening GH PR now.
Alex (Support): Noted. I'll follow up with customer once ledger write completes.
promo-webhook-bot: Webhook delivered: 200 OK to partner endpoint for claim_id cl_abc123 (attempt=1)
Alex (Support): Closing loop — will update SUP-2345 after confirmation.
